description:
Search the web and read the top pages in one step: returns the top web results plus the full visible text of the top 1-3 pages, each rendered in a real browser. Results that can't be read are skipped for the next one down. The fastest way to answer a question from fresh sources.

$0.015 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

num.description: How many pages to read (1-3, default 3).

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: search_and_read
title: Search and read
